About Spice Grill

A local favourite in Bridgeton

Spice Grill has become one of the East End's best-loved Indian takeaways — rated a perfect 5.0 from more than 3,000 reviews. That's not an accident: it's fresh ingredients, generous portions and curries cooked the way they should be.

Every dish starts from scratch when you order — marinades made daily, naan baked to order in the tandoor, and sauces built layer by layer. Order by phone and skip the middleman: your food goes straight from our kitchen to your table.

  • Cooked fresh to order, never reheated
  • Collection in around 15–20 minutes
  • Local delivery across Bridgeton, Dennistoun & Parkhead
